# libe_sqlite3-linux-s390x.so

s390x: SQLite built by GCC for SQLitePCLRaw. Its `switch` statements are GCC's jump tables (`clijh; risbgn; larl; lg; b 0(%rX,%rT)`).

- Source: the NuGet package SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3 2.1.10 (`https://www.nuget.org/api/v2/package/SQLitePCLRaw.lib.e_sqlite3/2.1.10`)
- Path in the source: `runtimes/linux-s390x/native/libe_sqlite3.so`
- SHA-256: `7d434a2bc586e0a936f47f48782ac66d6c4179d99b332f9605a4799ecafe7948`
- Size: 1482712 bytes (582797 compressed)
- License: SQLite is public domain; SQLitePCLRaw is Apache-2.0

`libe_sqlite3-linux-s390x.so.rizin.json.zst` holds what rizin 0.8.2 found (`binform-ab --save`);
`libe_sqlite3-linux-s390x.so.golden` holds what binform finds (`BINFORM_BLESS=1 cargo test fixtures`).
